display.purpose: Chapter headings on the manuscript surface. Used once per chapter view. The most authoritative typographic moment in the product.

headline.purpose: H2 headings within manuscript body text.

title.purpose: H3 within documents; in-product headings in dialogs and settings.

body.purpose: All prose on the paper surface. The most-read text in the product. Max line length enforced by 720px sheet container (~65–72ch).

body-ui.purpose: All text in the application shell: sidebar titles, panel copy, button labels, navigation items.

label.purpose: Section headers (uppercase), chapter numbers, word counts, timestamps, metadata. Monospace signals systematic measurement, not prose.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The bubble format menu and any future floating element (tooltip, popover, dropdown). The only shadow in the system. Deep ambient drop plus inner highlight.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions: button hover, input focus, sidebar item hover. Fast, directional, unobtrusive.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Bubble menu entry animation. Slight spring overshoot — the only choreographic moment in the system.

motion.name: ease-slide
motion.purpose: Panel slide-ins, sidebar item colour transitions.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Hide secondary elements (hide-sm class). Below this, the layout collapses to a single column.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Touch target expansion for toolbar buttons (44×44px minimum).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a surface: Save, Publish, Confirm. Sienna Ink fill, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.63 0.16 30); background: oklch(0.63 0.16 30); color: oklch(0.98 0 0); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.68 0.16 30); border-color: oklch(0.68 0.16 30); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.63 0.16 30); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Export, Share, Cancel. Border-only, transparent at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.34 0.012 50); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.95 0.008 80); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: oklch(0.245 0.014 50); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.63 0.16 30); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar-area actions where even a border would compete with content.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.78 0.012 80); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.245 0.014 50); color: oklch(0.95 0.008 80); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.63 0.16 30); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input with Label
components.description: Form field with uppercase mono label. Used in auth, book creation, settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.58 0.012 70); letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.34 0.012 50); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.245 0.014 50); color: oklch(0.95 0.008 80); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.63 0.16 30); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.46 0.012 60); } .ds-input--error { border-color: oklch(0.65 0.18 25); }

components.name: Bubble Format Menu
components.description: Floating format toolbar that appears above selected text. The only component in the system with elevation (box-shadow). Spring entry animation.
components.css: @keyframes ds-bubble-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px) scale(0.96); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } .ds-bubble { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; background: oklch(0.11 0.014 50 / 0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.10); border-radius: 11px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.07) inset; animation: ds-bubble-in 0.13s cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.68, 0, 1.2) both; } .ds-bubble-fmt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; } .ds-bubble-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; border: none; color: oklch(0.78 0.012 80); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s; } .ds-bubble-btn:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.10); color: oklch(0.95 0.008 80); } .ds-bubble-btn--on { background: oklch(0.63 0.16 30); color: #fff; } .ds-bubble-sep { width: 1px; height: 18px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.13); flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
A craftsman's studio at the edge of midnight — warm oak shelves, the smell of paper, a single lamp cutting the dark. The interface is the room: controlled, quiet, designed around one purpose. The manuscript is the work on the desk. Everything else earns its presence by serving it.

This is not a productivity suite. It is not a content platform, a wiki engine, or a document editor. It is a purpose-built writing environment where the act of authorship is treated as a serious craft. The chrome is subordinate, restrained, nearly invisible. The paper surface is generous, readable, luminous.

The palette lives in two worlds simultaneously: a warm-dark oak shell where tools wait in shadow, and a cream manuscript surface that glows in contrast. These two zones never bleed into each other. The shell stays dark; the page stays bright. Tension between them creates the sense of a focused workspace — a room built for writing.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark shell (oak-stained, amber-tinted) framing a luminous cream manuscript surface
Three typefaces in strict jurisdictions: IBM Plex Sans for chrome, Source Serif 4 for the page, IBM Plex Mono for counters and metadata
One accent colour (Sienna Ink) used with discipline; a second (Lamplight Amber) for progress and warmth signals
Flat tonal elevation: depth through luminance steps, not box shadows
Restrained component vocabulary: everything quiet at rest, responsive on interaction

rules.name: The Rarity Doctrine
rules.body: Sienna Ink occupies ≤10% of any given screen. Active chapter number, focus ring, one button, one tab underline. Its scarcity is the point. The moment it appears everywhere, it appears nowhere.

rules.name: The Two-World Rule
rules.body: Shell neutrals (Oak family) and manuscript neutrals (Writing Cream, Manuscript Ink) never mix. Do not use oak-surface as a background in the editor; do not use writing-cream as a panel background in the chrome.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Doctrine
rules.body: Every neutral in this system — dark or light — carries a fractional chroma toward hue 50–85 (amber-warm). Pure achromatic greys are forbidden. The warmth is what makes the studio feel like a room, not a UI kit.

rules.name: The Serif Jurisdiction Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 lives on the paper surface and nowhere else. It is forbidden in toolbar buttons, sidebar section headers, status bars, or panel labels. The moment a serif appears in chrome, the boundary between studio and manuscript dissolves.

rules.name: The Mono Counter Rule
rules.body: Every number that quantifies rather than narrates belongs in IBM Plex Mono: word counts, chapter numbers, timestamps, progress percentages. This is a typographic signal that the number is a measurement, not prose.

rules.name: The Shadowless Default Rule
rules.body: At rest, all surfaces are differentiated by background luminance, not by elevation. Borders mark edges; tonal steps mark hierarchy. A box shadow is a signal that an element has left its context. Use it only for genuinely floating elements.

rules.name: The Quiet Interface Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, and toolbar elements make no visual claims at rest. They darken on hover; they brighten only when active. The manuscript is louder than any control.

dos: Do keep Sienna Ink as the single interactive accent — one primary button, one active number, one focus ring per screen.
Do express depth through background luminance: oak-void → oak-dark → oak-surface → oak-surface-2 → oak-surface-3. Step through these levels in order.
Do keep Source Serif 4 exclusively on the manuscript surface.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric metadata: chapter counts, word counts, timestamps, progress percentages, section labels in uppercase.
Do tint every neutral toward amber (hue 50–85). Chroma 0.008–0.014 is enough.
Do enforce first-line indent (1.4em) on body prose paragraphs, reset to zero after headings and scene breaks.
Do use WCAG AA contrast minimums — 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and UI components — in both dark and light themes independently.
Do verify prefers-reduced-motion: disable the bubble-menu animation; preserve colour transitions.
donts: Don't use Notion's block-based page metaphor — no /commands, no drag-to-restructure blocks, no database tables.
Don't make this feel like Google Docs or Word — no ribbon toolbar, no track-changes mess, no document-property sidebars.
Don't build Scrivener-style cork boards, index-card grids, or project binder tree navigators.
Don't add blog-platform affordances — no read-time, subscriber counts, or public-first document framing.
Don't use pure achromatic colours (#888, oklch(0.5 0 0), gray-500). Every neutral must carry a fractional amber tint.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a coloured accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't mix paper and shell neutrals — writing-cream is reserved for the manuscript surface only.
Don't add a SaaS metric dashboard — no hero numbers, progress rings, or productivity widgets.
Don't add decorative shadows or glassmorphism to shell panels — floating shadow exists for one element only: the bubble menu.
